_comment: Which wall plates may rotate onto a session, and which may not. `in` is approval: `task images:wallpaper` installs the newest plate named there. `out` is a rejection and carries the reason; it wins over `in`, so a plate in both lists never rotates. Ids are `<day>/<name>.png` under published/wall, falling back to src/wall. A plate in neither list is unjudged: not rejected, just not in rotation yet — that is how a fresh generation waits for a look instead of going straight onto a screen.

out.2026-11-11/fern.png: reads as Fern and Frieren mixed into one character: the hair says Frieren, the outfit says Fern. The face is the defect, not the style.
